steps.title: Interpret incident and match graph entities
steps.detail: Matched 4 graph entities from the description/logs: Finance Report (matched 'finance-report'), Event Service (matched 'event-service'), Data Normalizer (matched 'normalizer'), Finance ETL Pipeline (matched 'finance-etl').
steps.reason: Ground the free-text incident in graph entities before running any relationship query.

steps.title: Trace dependency path
steps.detail: Traced upstream from 4 entities (6 nodes within 5 hops). Longest DEPENDS_ON chain: Finance ETL Pipeline → Data Normalizer → Event Service.
steps.reason: 4 systems are named in the logs; follow their dependencies upstream to find what they rely on.

steps.title: Inspect source change
steps.detail: Event Service v4.2 (doc doc-changelog) renamed `amount_cents`→`amount_minor`; logs mention ['amount_cents', 'amount_minor']; change precedes first error by 6 min.
steps.reason: Logs contain schema-type errors (KeyError / unknown field); look for a documented change on the traced services and check whether the logs corroborate it.

steps.title: Retrieve related incidents
steps.detail: 2 candidate precedent(s) by shared graph entities. INC-1873 (rank 9: same failure pattern (schema drift)); INC-2030 (rank 2: different failure pattern (capacity ≠ schema_drift))
steps.reason: Logs contain schema-type errors (KeyError / unknown field); look for earlier incidents touching the same entities.

steps.title: Retrieve historical resolution
steps.detail: INC-1873: cause = Event Service release v3.9 renamed `customer_ref` to `customer_id`; the normalizer mapping was not updated. Fix = Field alias mapping; verification test(s) = ['Contract test: alias mapping (INC-1873)']; source document(s) = ['Postmortem PM-1873'].
steps.reason: INC-1873 is the best-ranked precedent with a recorded fix; retrieve its cause, fix, source and test.

steps.title: Context Drift Guard: replay historical fix
steps.detail: Replayed Field alias mapping against current-schema fixtures: 0/2 assertions passed - KeyError: 'amount_cents'.
steps.reason: Do not trust the precedent blindly: replay its fix against current-schema fixtures to test whether it still applies.

steps.title: Find affected systems
steps.detail: From Event Service: 7 entities structurally exposed within 6 hops; 2 confirmed affected by the incident record; exposed but no recorded impact: API Gateway, Raw Events Stream, Usage Dataset.
steps.reason: Quantify blast radius: compare structural exposure with the impact recorded on the incident.

steps.title: Check memory validity
steps.detail: 7 memory record(s) touch these entities; potentially stale (a dependency changed after the memory was validated): none; already flagged needs-review: ['M-101', 'M-108', 'M-103']; recalled from earlier agent sessions: ['M-108', 'M-109'].
steps.reason: Check stored knowledge about these entities for staleness or conflict before relying on it.

steps.title: Look up owners
steps.detail: Owners: INC-2041 → Arjun Rao; Event Service → Platform Team; Finance ETL Pipeline → Data Engineering; Finance Report → Finance Analytics; Data Normalizer → Data Engineering.
steps.reason: Identify who owns the affected systems and the incident.

steps.title: Retrieve related decisions
steps.detail: Decisions: DR-07 Schema contract versioning (via owning team Platform Team); DR-09 Billing Dataset ownership moved to Data Engineering (via owning team Data Engineering)
steps.reason: Look for decision records that constrain the remediation.

steps.title: Retrieve linked evidence
steps.detail: 9 evidence record(s) already linked to INC-2041: ['EV-11', 'EV-1', 'EV-5', 'EV-2', 'EV-9', 'EV-7', 'EV-6', 'EV-10', 'EV-8'].
steps.reason: Load evidence already recorded for this incident so findings link to existing records.
